subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported model/provider override contract, and should that contract be `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or a dedicated override block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron schema, provider precedence, session-state isolation, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not pick the permanent API shape alone.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Add model/provider validation and transient run-scoped application to the existing payload-style contract, with tests proving no main-session override leakage.

options.title: Add explicit job override fields
options.body: Create a top-level or `sessionOverride` contract that applies across payload kinds, accepting the broader schema/docs and migration surface.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` as the supported per-job model path and leave main-session system events tied to the target session's model state.

recommendation.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
recommendation.body: Add model/provider validation and transient run-scoped application to the existing payload-style contract, with tests proving no main-session override leakage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron session-target and model-routing history makes this the best available owner for the product/API choice.
